scope: Exactly four images viewed: Verren small NPC sprite, Sela01 turnaround, batch79 v1 and v2. Read existing style audit. No other images or game package inspected.
findings: V2 visibly compresses the torso and legs relative to Sela01 and v1. Broad dark stepped contours and large shirt/cape patches improve compact shape readability. V1 still has elongated anatomy, eye whites, separated fingers and ornate rope shading.

V2 retains the brown bun, short teal cape, oatmeal rolled sleeves, grey-brown trousers, brown belt/boots and one readable rope loop. No Verren hood, beard, armor or weapon leakage is visible. Exactly one empty-handed civilian in a modest left-facing three-quarter stance.

Face and hands are abbreviated in v2; rope becomes a simple broad loop and boot buckle detail is removed. Small trouser/hair shade subdivisions and warm orange skin remain. Its prominent head/eye and clean bold design still read more cartoon-like than the tiny gritty Verren reference.

Hard block silhouettes are improved, but fine tonal variation remains inside clusters and grey backdrop. This is still a rendered pixel-style illustration, not verified flat-palette, integer-grid, nearest-neighbor or transparent sprite art. Existing producer background/color measurements support this limit and are not an official palette specification.

One public single-facing Verren reference cannot establish native dimensions, all-direction anatomy, a universal palette or game-version compatibility. Source provenance is inherited from the recorded metadata, not newly checked online or in the local game.

Prefer v2 only as this bounded calibration concept. Preserve Sela01 and v1. Stop further generation; cleanup, palette, transparency, animation and game integration remain separate production work, with no runtime or deployment claim.
